description: Phase FRP-7 V1.5 supplement §22.1 stay-online metric. Family-side anonymized session uptime ≥ 99% over 7 simulated days under the rig's accelerated clock (one tick == one wall-clock minute). Drives the FRP-3 selector pipeline through a synthetic 7-day TIC trace; asserts no single outage window exceeds the supplement §22.1 budget (rotation must heal inside 60 s on every observed dip). Day-7 final assertion: cumulative_downtime_minutes / total_minutes ≤ 0.01.
